title: Diwali Celebration @ 50th & France
venue_name: Nolan Mains Residences at 50th and France
description: We welcome the community to celebrate with Bollywood dance, live music, artisan vendors, henna and festive bites! Free & open to the public!
long_description:
We welcome the community to celebrate with Bollywood dance, live music, artisan vendors, henna and festive bites! Free & open to the public!

About this Event

The Edina Asian American Alliance (EAAA) and 50th & France are excited to bring their annual Diwali Celebration to light on Friday, October 23, 2026.
This Festival of Lights celebration is free, family-friendly, and open to all who wish to come together as community for a weekend filled with music, dance, cultural activities, shopping, and food!
The event will be held from 6 to 8 p.m. on Friday, October 23, 2026, at The Plaza at Nolan Mains, 3945 Market St., Edina, 55424. Free parking is available in the North, Center, and South ramps.
“Diwali is meant to bring the community together to celebrate the light of life overcoming obstacles. We are excited about our partnership between EAAA and 50th & France to share the traditions of Diwali with our community,” said Raja Anton Chinnakotla (2006-2026), Founding Diwali Committee and whom the Celebration will be dedicated.
Get ready for an unforgettable evening of music and movement as local groups light up the stage with high-energy fusion numbers and traditional South Asian performances. From dynamic dance troupes to soulful singers, this kickoff will set the perfect tone for a weekend of activity and celebration.
Featured performances include:
· Bhangra Thrills
· Bharatanatyam – Nrityavidyala School of Dance
· Dhol Tasha – Marathi Association of Minnesota (MAM)
· Fazel Haris
· Mira Babal
· School of India for Languages and Culture (SILC)
· South Asian Arts & Theater House (SAATH)
Hometown leader & Mrs. Minnesota International Feroza Mehta will serve as our first-time emcee! Decorations by Artfully Nimble.
The first 200 attendees will have the opportunity to receive a specially curated treat by Lunds & Byerlys with a $5 donation toward EAAA Diwali!
In addition to performance and activities such as free/EAAA sponsored Henna (Art by Meenakshi and Aparna) and Diya Pai
